profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Elkhounds share strong hunting instincts, though their working styles differ. The black Norwegian tends to be calm and devoted, while its grey counterpart is fearless and energetic. These dogs track large game, either on a leash with the hunter or working loose; the Laika members also hunt other kinds of game.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A hunting family with strong game-finding instincts, Elkhounds include both leash workers and dogs that hunt loose.
